name: Bitbucket

sources.title: Bitbucket homepage — 'Get it Free' signup for Bitbucket Cloud
Atlassian ID signup (batch-provided URL) — JS-rendered, returned no readable content

requirements: Free Atlassian/Bitbucket Cloud account ('Get it Free' on bitbucket.org)
Bitbucket is a code host — a 'listing' means a public workspace profile, public repository, and README linking to the product
preparation: Workspace name and public repo name
README content with the product URL and description
Profile website field for the workspace/user profile
workflow: From bitbucket.org click 'Get it Free' / 'Try it now' to create an Atlassian account (id.atlassian.com/signup)
Create a workspace, then a public repository for the product (or a profile/landing repo)
Commit a README that describes the product and links to its site
watchFor: id.atlassian.com/signup is JS-rendered — headless fetching returns an empty shell; use a real browser
Value is a public repo + profile, not a directory listing; set repository visibility to public explicitly
Bitbucket no longer supports Mercurial; Git only
Unknown whether profile/repo links are dofollow
countsAsLive: A publicly accessible bitbucket.org/<workspace>/<repo> URL whose README links to the product, plus a profile website link
unknowns: Link attributes on profile and README outbound links
Whether Atlassian signup requires email verification before public repos are visible
